lines: Eee! Was that a SONG? A really LOUD, crashy one!
I'm Melody! I'm shaking. Are you shaking?
Eee! Bramble said you'd come! I'm Melody!
{player}: Are you... a capybara?
Capybara AND pop star! And I wrote a new song!
But my best friend Heather has to hear it first. Will you fetch her?
Heather's in the green meadow! Horns and a scooter!
You found her! This one's called Tick Tock, Don't Stop!
Tick tock, the clock goes round, my feet won't touch the ground!
(Heather whoops. The little aliens clap!)
Thank you! You're my first fan!
Oh! Dash is waiting by the portal for you!
Eee! A new face! I'm Melody!
{player}: Are you... a capybara?
Capybara AND pop star! Everybody likes capybaras.
Come dance with me some time!
Thank you, thank you! Oh, it's YOU!
Come up! Press {groove} on the beat. Eight in a row!
Boom... tss... BOOM!
My very own stage!
A show every evening, right by my portal.
Dance with me! Press {groove} on the beat.
{player}! I wrote a song about you! It's just your name. Lots.
Can I come with you? I'll be your soundtrack!
Press {groove} and I'll get everyone dancing!
Yay! Press {friend} when you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Still want me along?
Yay! Press {friend} when you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
{player}! My favourite backup dancer!
Come to my show tonight, six till nine!
...and the stars all go YES, YES, YES! Oh, hi!
My new song is called "Yes!" Be my backup dancer?
{player}: Maybe!
Maybes are just shy yeses!
Dance break! Wiggle with me!
Shoulders, hips, ponytail!
La la LAAA. The flowers are my audience.
Nervous? Breathe in for four, out for four.
Bramble popped out of the ground! I screamed SO loud.
Now we're best friends!
(Big yawn.) Pop stars need sleep too.

rotate: Just practising my sassy face. How was it?
All my songs are happy. Even the sad ones.
